scope: Read-only review followed by parent-authorized minimal validator fixes; all counterexamples are synthetic fixtures, never training data.

findings.finding: Distinct path strings can alias a single RAW across all declared train/validation scenes. No canonical/inode/content identity check existed.
findings.reproduction: 30 clips, 6 scene labels, 1 resolved RAW: overall_pass=true before fix.
findings.fix: Resolve within dataset root; require relative paths; group by physical inode and full SHA256; reject physical aliases, symlinks, hardlinks and byte-identical copies; store source identities.

findings.finding: Non-finite positive numbers and black level at/above white were accepted. NaN black and infinite fps passed full validation.
findings.fix: Require finite positive numbers and black < white.

after_fix.error: black_level_dn must be a finite positive number

findings.finding: Automatic pass cannot prove physical scene independence, actual motion labels, processing bypass, sharp dynamic target, optical motion blur, true low gain or correct CFA/black level.
findings.fix: Report training_ready=false, admission_status and mandatory manual-review evidence even when automatic checks pass.

findings.finding: Zero/one-frame clips could fail with memmap/IndexError rather than an explicit missing temporal pair error.
findings.fix: Clear ValueError for fewer than two complete frames.

findings.finding: Quiet adjacent-frame noise underestimates temporally correlated or fixed-pattern target error; smoothing/NR can improve this proxy while removing true detail.

spatially_blurred.limitation: Declared nr_disabled=true is not hardware verification; temporal differences do not estimate time-invariant pattern error.

static_pattern_added.limitation: Declared nr_disabled=true is not hardware verification; temporal differences do not estimate time-invariant pattern error.

findings.finding: Dimensions are declared even integers, not inferred; only sampled pairs/pixels are checked for alignment and quality. No proof of every frame, CFA or full-time metadata stability.
findings.recommendation: Keep actual capture settings, chart/lens-cap controls, and fixed-ISP visual review as admission evidence; do not relabel automatic diagnostics as independent clean truth.

findings.finding: Original symlinks could be retargeted after source hashing; mutable metadata was not bound to the report.
findings.fix: Before/after parsing and final manifest SHA256 checks, report manifest SHA256, and final re-resolution of every source clip against its recorded target.
findings.tests: Manifest mutation during parsing/quality checks and symlink retargeting are rejected.

tests.coverage: Existing 5 plus 19 new cases; duplicates, distinct-file automatic-pass fixture with manual review outstanding, invalid metadata/path/frame counts, mutable manifest and retargeted symlink.
